heavy_strike.name: Heavy Strike
heavy_strike.description: A crushing blow to your target for 200% attack damage.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Sweep your weapon around you, hitting all nearby enemies for 110% attack damage.

charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Dash to your target and strike it for 120% attack damage.

war_cry.name: War Cry
war_cry.description: Let out a battle shout: +25% attack for 8 seconds.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.description: Raise your guard: take 40% less damage for 6 seconds.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Spin with your blade outstretched, hitting every enemy in a wide circle for 160% attack damage.
